lessons.lesson: Use runtime PM autosuspend for aggregate codec and SDW children instead of PM_SLEEP-only supply policy.
lessons.condition: Keep runtime outcomes fail-closed until board logs are available.

lessons.lesson: Cache-only until SDW attach + cache sync on attach/resume is an upstream-accepted lifecycle pattern.
lessons.condition: WCD9378 SDW identity/paging confirmation is still required.

lessons.lesson: Reset should be modeled through reset GPIO descriptors, not vendor pinctrl state APIs.
lessons.condition: Board DTS must provide valid reset-gpios wiring.

lessons.lesson: MBHC should be integrated via shared wcd-mbhc-v2 API, with codec-specific field/IRQ mapping only.
lessons.condition: WCD9378 field/register mapping must come from downstream + datasheet evidence.

lessons.lesson: Class-H should be controlled through shared controller allocation and state transitions.
lessons.condition: WCD9378 class-H enum/base decision remains blocked pending runtime evidence.

lessons.lesson: LE accepted architecture removes parent callback coupling and platform private handles used by LA.
lessons.condition: Conversion should reject vendor callback plumbing.

lessons.lesson: LE replace of custom IRQ wrappers with regmap-irq + threaded IRQ is maintainable and reviewable.
lessons.condition: IRQ map must match WCD9378 interrupt layout.

lessons.lesson: Maintainers accepted split Kconfig symbols (core + SDW) and Makefile wiring for WCD family codecs.
lessons.condition: Symbols must reflect real helper dependencies and transport split.

lessons.lesson: LA debug-only facilities (debugfs peek/poke, hwdep cal) were not carried into LE and should remain non-upstream.
lessons.condition: Any debug-only aid must stay out of upstream patch scope.

lessons.lesson: LA uses explicit enumeration delays/retries; LE still has bounded waits but no ad-hoc recovery hacks.
lessons.condition: Do not derive WCD9378 recovery policy without Monday runtime logs.

lessons.lesson: Regmap shape changed LA->LE (16-bit/RBTREE to 32-bit/MAPLE); conversion should treat this as an intentional upstream adaptation pattern.
lessons.condition: Only apply when downstream register-domain evidence supports address width and cache behavior.

lessons.lesson: WCD938x LE pattern does not prove WCD9378 SDW identity or paging behavior.
lessons.condition: Keep SDW identity/paging blockers as runtime-evidence gated.
